# `engagements-shared/`

The ADR-0008 scenario: **one** Engagement cited by gates on **two different projects**. The
5 mmscfd allocation is simultaneously an engagement with SKK Migas and PGN/Pertagas and the
binding evidence requirement for G1 across the whole gas pillar, so a projection that
copied its state would have it current in one place and stale in the other.

Also covers the two counterparty shapes — a list and a bare string — and the rung at the
bottom of the ladder, which is a recorded position rather than an absence.
